name: BIO Protocol
gap: Spot launch 2025-01-03 10:00 UTC on Binance with 1,296,529,168 BIO circulating (39.05% of 3.32B) (Binance listing announcement). Vesting per KuCoin Research and tokenomics.com: Core Contributors 21.2%, Advisors 4.2% and Investors 13.6% all have a 12-month cliff (then 6-year / 6-year / 4-year vesting); Community Auction 50% at TGE + 12-month linear; Ecosystem Incentives 25% 100% at TGE (DAO-controlled); Molecule 5% and Molecule Ecosystem Fund 5% 48-month linear with no cliff listed. First insider unlock is therefore the 12-month cliff end, computed as 2026-01-03 (TGE + 12 months); no fetched page states the exact claim day or the tranche size, and it is outside the window. Caveat: Molecule (the company that incubated BIO, 5%) appears to stream from TGE; tokenomics.com classes it as 'Foundation', so it is not treated as an insider here - if it is counted as team, the first insider unlock would be the launch day (atLaunch true, stream). In-window check: the only flows between 2025-01-03 and 2025-11-16 are the auction 12-month linear stream and the Molecule streams; no single-day unlock of >=25% of circulating (~325M+ tokens) was found. Tokenomist event tables are paywalled; its 2026 figures (78% unlocked, 'no upcoming cliff') do not fit a 1+6-year schedule and were not used. The tokenomics.com page shows TGE as 'January 3, 2024', a typo for 2025.

name: Flux (RunOnFlux, formerly ZelCash/ZEL)
gap: Flux is a mined proof-of-work + node-reward coin with no investor/VC vesting schedule. It began as ZelCash, 'launched in January 2018' (Penguin FA Medium review; exact day not found), with an 11M ZEL (5%) premined Development Fund: Zel Foundation 7.9M (790k unlocked per year) and core team 3.1M ('50% unlocked each year over two years'). Zelwiki (Zel Foundation page) gives the dev fund as ~13.2M ZEL. The first insider unlock is therefore the first core-team dev-fund release in 2018-2019; the exact date could not be confirmed (null), and it is well before the window. ZEL was swapped 1:1 into FLUX by hard fork on 2021-03-27 (runonflux.com primer; a 'migration' outside the window); at the fork the foundation got a locked 10M FLUX airdrop with no release date given. Window 2022-05-01 to 2025-11-16: new supply comes only from block rewards (halvings 2023-02-08 and 2025-08) and parallel-asset mining; a Nov 2023 allocation snapshot (Bitkub help page) shows only 0.7% team and 2.9% foundation. No vesting cliff or single-day unlock of >=25% of circulating exists or was reported, so no qualifying events.

Window 2024-04-01 to 2025-11-16: only the tails of linear vesting plus discretionary treasury/emission releases; no single-day unlock of >=25% of circulating (~60M) was found.
